# This is a "pirated" mod that imitates [Malum](https://modrinth.com/mod/malum)

The mod has added some Vows

Vows cannot be directly used or synthesized like some props. They require players to use a soul brazier to add "agreements". Each player can bind 3 Vows, after which a cost will be required to erase them
